reason: A local Markdown-based knowledge and task management plugin that records notes, manages structured todos, searches Vault files, and summarizes conversation context into a knowledge base.

summaries.zh: 将笔记、待办和对话摘要统一保存到用户指定的本地 Markdown Vault 中的知识管理插件。
summaries.en: A knowledge-management plugin that stores notes, todos, and conversation summaries in a user-selected local Markdown Vault.

capabilities: Creates and updates local Markdown journal, knowledge, and todo files in a user-selected Vault
Reads and searches files within the configured Vault
Uses the current conversation model to summarize selected conversation context into structured notes
Stores configuration in local YAML files
